description:
With a root `defmodule Geo.Pt do @type t :: integer end`, `@spec f(Geo.Pt.t) :: integer` prints `error[resolve/type-alias]: compiler2 could not resolve function contract for `f`: unknown type name `Geo.Pt.t`` with no location (`--> <generated>`), and the program then runs and prints its output on interp and run. Two faults: an error diagnostic that does not stop the compile, and a report with no span.

The unknown-name half of this probe goes away with fz-sc8.25 (dotted types resolve their module the way other names do). To reproduce after that, name a type that does not exist: `@spec f(Geo.Pt.nope) :: integer`.

Wanted: the compile stops, and the report points at the type name in the @spec.
title: A contract that cannot be resolved stops the compile and says where
